description: This Java class implements the <iterate> element for a mini-language, enabling iteration over collections, entity lists, and iterators within a custom scripting or processing framework. It manages iteration logic, exception handling for break/continue, and gathers artifact info.

classes.name: Iterate
classes.description: Implements the <iterate> element, handling iteration over collections, entity lists, and iterators, with support for break and continue exceptions, and gathering artifact info.
